message:

hold_reason: Refund discrepancy on order 201: the signed batch order requests 3873 cents, but the refunds table and Alpha's reported applied refunds show only 1083 cents. Paying out from net_balance would be based on the 1083 figure and could overpay by 2790 cents. Other orders (203: 18687, 204: 11000) match. Needs human review before any payouts are recorded.
